This is a pretend Windows 11 desktop that runs in your browser. Nothing you do here touches your real computer. Practice the whole Brainstem setup once, then do it for real on the installer page. If you get stuck at any point, the Get help form reaches a person.

The practice computer needs a screen at least 900 pixels wide. Open this page on a laptop or desktop, or go straight to the installer page.
